QuestInfo.name: The Warrior's Next Journey
QuestInfo.0: Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Swordsman, I feel the urge to learn even more.
QuestInfo.1: Does #b#p511##k of #b#m10004000##k have even greater lessons to teach me?
QuestInfo.2: #b#p511##k of #b#m10004000##k seemed surprised to see how much stronger I had become compared to before.

0.0: Finally, I've reached level 30! It hasn't been easy, but now I'm confident I can stand as a true Swordsman who won't lose to anyone. Still... is this really enough? The world is vast, and I find myself wanting to learn more.
0.1: I should probably visit #b#p511##k in #b#m10004000##k again. He might be able to teach me something new.

1.0: Whoa, you've definitely grown up! You don't look small and weak anymore... Rather, I can now feel your Warrior presence.
1.1: There's no need for a long explanation. You want to learn more, don't you? Seeing young people like you rekindles my own fighting spirit!
